title: Build standalone secscan
description: Implement the approved standalone Go AppSec scanner product defined by openspec/changes/build-secscan.

title: Walking skeleton: scan with Gitleaks
description:
## Outcome

`secscan --scanners gitleaks <repository>` запускает digest-pinned Gitleaks
через Docker или Podman и выводит один детерминированный schema-v1 JSON report
без secret value и source snippet.

Эта задача также поставляет тонкий `tracecheck`, который связывает OpenSpec
scenarios с components/tests, выдаёт baseline/target/final evidence и сверяет
changed-file set с declared scope.

## OpenSpec References

Target:

- CLI contract / Machine-readable stdout
- CLI contract / Exit status
- Container runtime / Safe repository mount
- Container runtime / Runtime unavailable
- Scanner orchestration / Scanner selection
- Canonical finding model / Deterministic result
- Canonical finding model / Secret redaction
- Honest coverage / Coverage envelope
- Reproducibility / Pinned scanner image
- Supported environments / CI execution
- Development traceability / Trace links
- Development traceability / Phased evidence
- Development traceability / Scope verification

Остальные scenarios явно deferred в trace manifest к epic `secscan-ij8`.

## Ownership

- `go.mod`
- `.gitignore`
- `cmd/secscan/`
- `cmd/tracecheck/`
- `internal/container/`
- `internal/gitleaks/`
- `internal/report/`
- `internal/tracecheck/`
- `testdata/`
- `openspec/changes/build-secscan/trace.json`
- `openspec/changes/build-secscan/design.md`
- `openspec/changes/build-secscan/specs/secscan/spec.md`
- `openspec/changes/build-secscan/.stale.json`
- `.beads/issues.jsonl` as the sole evidence sink

## Acceptance

- Unit tests first demonstrate parser redaction, deterministic report bytes,
  safe container argv and trace validation failures.
- `tracecheck` derives complete scenario coverage from the delta spec.
- `tracecheck` uses the manifest baseline commit without a CLI override.
- Scope includes committed and working-tree changes since baseline; both paths
  of a rename are checked.
- Evidence aggregates every phase command and includes implementation state
  identity plus canonical Beads authority hash.
- A real Docker Gitleaks run against a synthetic fixture passes; Podman is also
  exercised when available.
- `gofmt -d .`, `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...`, OpenSpec validation,
  staleness check, security review and independent review pass.

## Safe Abandonment

Revert the granular tracecheck and Gitleaks commits. Scanner containers use
`--rm`; temporary report directories are removed after each run.
close_reason: Gitleaks walking skeleton complete. Baseline c3878351ce57a586fd5ca11cb4cacc9bb8bf2f61; final state 53b92a9283019f63f4a4e547ff66379fdadecda12709d49aa70897049b44361a. OpenSpec, staleness, format, vet, unit/race tests, real Docker acceptance, CLI smoke, security review, and independent review passed.

title: Progress dashboard: TTY and CI rendering
description:
## Outcome

`secscan` показывает live dashboard в TTY и стабильные plain events в CI,
сохраняя stdout одним JSON-документом.

## OpenSpec References

- Progress presentation / Interactive dashboard
- Progress presentation / Plain progress
- Progress presentation / Color disabled
- Progress presentation / Progress disabled
- Progress presentation / Progress mode validation
- CLI contract / Machine-readable stdout
- Supported environments / CI execution

## Ownership

- `go.mod`
- `go.sum`
- `cmd/secscan/`
- `internal/progress/`
- `internal/gitleaks/`
- `openspec/changes/build-secscan/trace.json`
- `.beads/issues.jsonl`

## Acceptance

- `--progress auto|tty|plain|off` работает по spec.
- TTY dashboard отображает scanner, stage, elapsed bar, findings и status.
- Plain events имеют стабильный порядок полей и не содержат ANSI.
- `NO_COLOR` отключает цвета, сохраняя renderer.
- Cursor восстанавливается при success, error и cancellation.
- JSON stdout не меняется.

## Verification

- Focused progress/CLI tests.
- PTY smoke для live dashboard.
- `go test -race ./...`.
- target/final trace evidence.
- Independent review.

title: Build pinned Opengrep image and rules
description:
## Outcome

Project-owned multi-arch Opengrep image собирается воспроизводимо из pinned
Opengrep 1.29.0 binaries и оригинального MIT rule pack v1.

## OpenSpec References

- Language SAST / Honest rule coverage
- Reproducibility / Pinned scanner image
- Reproducibility / Cached rules
- Container runtime / Safe repository mount

## Ownership

- `scanner/opengrep/`
- `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- `LICENSES/`
- `internal/opengrep/image.go`
- `internal/opengrep/image_test.go`
- `openspec/changes/build-secscan/trace.json`
- `.beads/issues.jsonl`

## Acceptance

- Alpine base, Opengrep assets and hashes закреплены.
- Image запускается non-root и содержит LGPL license/source notice.
- Python/TypeScript rules имеют отдельную MIT license.
- Rule digest/count детерминированы.
- Image готовится один раз до parallel fan-out.
- Real local build и positive/negative rule fixtures проходят на arm64.

## Verification

- Dockerfile/static provenance checks.
- Opengrep rule tests.
- Real image build and version probe.
- target/final trace evidence.
- Independent security review.

title: Add Python and TypeScript SAST jobs
description:
## Outcome

`python-sast` и `typescript-sast` запускаются параллельно с Gitleaks, используют
offline Opengrep image/rules и объединяются в deterministic schema-v1 report.

## OpenSpec References

- Scanner orchestration / Parallel execution
- Scanner orchestration / Partial failure
- Scanner orchestration / Scanner selection
- Language SAST / Python files
- Language SAST / TypeScript files
- Language SAST / No matching files
- Language SAST / Honest rule coverage
- Language SAST / Scanner output isolation
- Honest coverage / Coverage envelope
- Honest coverage / Traversal disclosure

## Ownership

- `cmd/secscan/`
- `internal/discovery/`
- `internal/opengrep/`
- `internal/orchestrator/`
- `internal/report/`
- `testdata/`
- `openspec/changes/build-secscan/trace.json`
- `.beads/issues.jsonl`

## Acceptance

- Tracked и untracked nonignored Python/TypeScript files обнаруживаются NUL-safe.
- Absolute/traversal/symlink targets отклоняются.
- Jobs независимы по status, timeout, findings и coverage.
- Opengrep DTO не выпускает source snippets/metavars/raw messages.
- Scanner coverage сортируется; report bytes детерминированы.
- Один scanner failure сохраняет успешные результаты; all-failed даёт exit 1.
- Real Python и TypeScript container fixtures находят ожидаемые issues.

## Verification

- Discovery/parser/orchestration TDD.
- Real Docker acceptance для обоих languages.
- `go test -race ./...`.
- target/final trace evidence.
- Independent Go/security review.
